title: @ycforge/pilot materialize — materializer dispatch error codes and .tf.json output schemas
description: Machine-readable contract for Project C materializer dispatch (spec 014): the catalog of MTL_* error/diagnostic codes and the two Terraform JSON file shapes generated by dispatch into the infra directory.

dispatchDiagnostic.title: Dispatch diagnostic
dispatchDiagnostic.description: Emitted when selection (MTL_COLLISION / MTL_UNHANDLED_ARTIFACT) or materialization (MTL_MATERIALIZE_FAILED / MTL_FILENAME_COLLISION / MTL_INVALID_TERRAFORM_ADDRESS / MTL_OUTPUT_NAME_COLLISION) fails. codes compared via MTL_* constants, never string literals (Constitution V).

artifactId.description: app_id of the artifact that failed (for unhandled, materialize-failed, filename-collision, invalid-address, output-collision).

materializerIds.description: All materializer ids claiming supports (for MTL_COLLISION) or registered ids (for MTL_UNHANDLED_ARTIFACT).

materializerId.description: Materializer id that threw during materialize (for MTL_MATERIALIZE_FAILED).

filename.description: Computed filename involved in collision (for MTL_FILENAME_COLLISION).

terraformResourceFileSchema.title: Generated <app_id>.ycsf.tf.json
terraformResourceFileSchema.description: One Terraform resource block per app, produced by dispatch serialization. Keys in configuration objects are emitted lexicographically (FR-009).

^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$.description: Provider-specific configuration for this resource name. Key-value structure dictated by Terraform provider schema — opaque to C.

outputsFileSchema.title: Generated 00-ycsf-outputs.tf.json
outputsFileSchema.description: All materializer-declared outputs (via OutputBuilder.declare), serialized into a single Terraform outputs block. Only generated when at least one output was declared; output names must be unique globally across all materializer calls (MTL_OUTPUT_NAME_COLLISION).

value.description: Terraform expression wrapped with ${...} during serialization.

errorCodes.title: MTL_* error code catalog
errorCodes.description: All materializer-dispatch and serialization error codes (spec 014). Distinct MTL_* family, separate from PML_* (project-model) and BRG_* (plugin-registry) codes. Compared via constants in src/contracts/materialize.ts, never string literals (Constitution V).

MTL_COLLISION.description: Two or more materializers claim supports=true for the same artifact type (FR-003). Selection error; materialize is never called for any artifact (FR-017, all-or-nothing).

MTL_UNHANDLED_ARTIFACT.description: No materializer supports the artifact type (FR-004). Error, not warning (Constitution V); all-or-nothing with MTL_COLLISION (FR-017).

MTL_MATERIALIZE_FAILED.description: Materializer threw or rejected during materialize() (FR-006). Abort-on-first: subsequent artifacts are not materialized; partial results are not returned.

MTL_FILENAME_COLLISION.description: Two or more TerraformResource values computed to the same .ycsf.tf.json filename (FR-010). Defensive check; prevented by app_id uniqueness (spec 011).

MTL_INVALID_TERRAFORM_ADDRESS.description: TerraformResource.type or .name contains characters invalid for Terraform identifier grammar [a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]* (FR-011).

MTL_OUTPUT_NAME_COLLISION.description: Duplicate output name declared via OutputBuilder.declare() across materializer calls (FR-013). Constitution V: collision = error, never merge.
